title: Kiosk for Breaking Fast, Topkapi Palace
visualBrief: Iftar/Kiosk for Breaking Fast: open six-post dark-metal canopy over a low pale stone platform with three short baluster guards/open garden entry, broad gilded eaves, curved rectangular bell/cushion roof, four small corner finials and tall central spindle with a simplified open crest. Gold beaded/scalloped eave border and dark plain soffit; no copied calligraphic crest/art or independent Baghdad/pool/precinct balustrade.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Named Topkapi site Q170495 member OSM way1272157518 v1/native35185644246350, layer1 independent pavilion canopy. Exact four-corner roof retained. Internal+X northeast follows the long roof; internal+Z southeast faces the garden entry, with the city-view edge at internal-Z. Independent surrounding terrace rails/palace buildings remain native context.
